extracted.intended_audience: general public, prospective donors, researchers, students, and campus visitors
extracted.subtask_description: An institutional 'About' page describing the Salk Institute's mission, values, community and outreach programs, visiting information, and contact/policy links. It communicates the Institute's research priorities and expectations for community engagement and public interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — foundational, collaborative, risk-taking research addressing pressing challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institute’s mission is to drive foundational, collaborative, risk-taking research that addresses society’s most pressing challenges, including cancer, Alzheimer's disease, and agricultural vulnerability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text emphasizes the focus on foundational science as central to institutional activity and highlights priority challenge areas (cancer, Alzheimer's, agricultural vulnerability) as examples of target problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foundational science underpins translational efforts
rubrics_metrics.description: Foundational science underpins all translational efforts, generating insights that enable new medicines and innovations worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames success criteria for research as producing insights that can be translated into medical and other innovations; implies expectation that basic research should have a line-of-sight to broader translational impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community & Engagement values: excellence, integrity, and respect
rubrics_metrics.description: Salk’s Office of Community & Engagement team is committed to reinforcing the goals of a campus community that broadly engages members and supporters of the Institute in activities and interactions that incorporate excellence, integrity, and respect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets behavioral and engagement standards for campus activities and external interactions — engagement efforts should be broad and reflect the named institutional values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education outreach goal: inspire the next generation of scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: Through multiple programs, Salk inspires San Diego County students of all ages to become the next generation of scientists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outreach programs are expected to be multi‑modal and targeted to foster scientific interest across K–12 and other age groups within the local county; the explicit aim is inspiration and pipeline development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visiting/Tours requirement: docent-led tours and pre-registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Docent-led tours to visit the Salk campus are available Monday through Friday. Pre-registration for all tours is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational requirement for visitors: tours are scheduled weekdays and visitors must pre-register; this is the procedural policy governing public visits to the architecture/campus.
